searches.reason: Develop practical probes of whether NextItNet uses recent, coherent intent or stale interactions. Compare original histories with order shuffles, old-prefix removal and recent-event ablations; test causal leakage and final-nonpadding readout on left-padded sequences. Relate ranking changes to the dilated convolution receptive field, while treating perturbation effects as sensitivity evidence rather than proof of user intent.
searches.query: NextItNet dilated causal convolution sequential recommendation temporal sensitivity diagnostics history perturbation recency intent drift receptive field 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Translate feedback about broad relevance, duplicates and practical fit into auditable diagnostics using only histories, timestamps, titles and descriptions. Seek interpretable lexical and interaction-based probes that distinguish specific recent matches from broad similarity, report metadata coverage and uncertainty, and validate suspected redundancy or incompatibility against explicit feedback from the twenty training users without inventing attributes or simulator traits.
searches.query: explainable recommendation diagnostic evaluation specific intent complement substitute redundancy accessory compatibility item titles descriptions user rejection feedback uncertainty 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostic signals reliably identify ranking failures rather than artifacts of sampled negatives or sparse data. Seek user-level bootstrap intervals, support-normalized error slices, controlled synthetic failure tests and comparisons of sampled-candidate versus full-catalog diagnostics. Keep the pinned validation evaluator unchanged, report undefined measurements as unavailable, and connect validated failures to components or training signals within one NextItNet model per category.
searches.query: sequential recommender diagnostic metric validation sampled negatives full catalog ranking bias user bootstrap confidence intervals controlled perturbations slice reliability 2024 2025 2026
